doc_sources.note: Fetched 2026-08-20, HTTP 200. Five categories (Catalogues, Certificates, Forms, Instructions for use, eIFU), all hrefs in the served HTML as /ustomed/download/<32-hex>. No REF and no filename in the URL. What is published is QMS-level (MDSAP, "MP" quality certificate) -- NO declaration of conformity and no EC certificate exists in either language mirror. One IFU exceeded 10 MB; a certificate fetched had no text layer. Second alias is the vendor-master spelling and reads as a FORMER company name against the same register entry (HRA 451050) -- strong lead, not verified. RE-AUTHORED portal 2026-08-21: this is an HTML LISTING page, not a document. It was kind:"direct" while nothing read that key; the playbook DISCOVER rung now fetches direct sources, and FETCH has no content-type gate -- a listing page would be archived as an unreadable PDF and dead-end at EXTRACT silently. Turning it into documents is the crawl recipe (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-21-playbook-crawl-recipe-design.md).
